text: A receiving SMTP server rejects recipients it cannot deliver to (relaying denied) rather than accepting the message.
A receiving SMTP server must not reply 250 to DATA when the message could not be stored for any recipient; it must return a failure reply.
A receiving SMTP server prepends a Received: trace header to the accepted message content.
An inbound REQUEST imports the full event (recurrence, duration, location, participants) into the invitee's calendar.
An inbound REPLY updates the replying attendee's participationStatus on the UID-correlated event, not the event-level status.
A received text/calendar body part with method=REPLY is processed as an iTIP scheduling response.
The text/calendar part is located and decoded via a MIME parser (honouring Content-Transfer-Encoding), not raw byte scanning.
